adaptations.scanout.s: Removed asset-specific loading/error raster and unused 256-byte scratch allocation. Put optional WalkBlitRow in a discardable section. Normal raster, pixel pipeline, UART slots and timing retained. Linear 107-byte rows now use register address generation and latched base/camera; all 28 camera offsets and both buffers match prior SPI/DAC cycles exactly.
adaptations.videoMode.def.h: 160x128 window with render start 68 and the same 264-cycle HSync budget.
adaptations.mixer/three.s: BARB_SID replaces the 24-cycle ADPCM4 music decode slot with padded PCM4 playback. Effect lanes, FIFO contract and 240-cycle HSync timing are retained and tested.
adaptations.stream_diskio.py: Service AudioRefill after successful raw sector reads as well as retries. Separate SID disk/synthesis guards permit FAT traversal servicing without recursive filesystem access.
adaptations.mixer/generated/three_luts.inc: The valid ADPCM planes are unchanged. Existing unreachable tails hold pause/CRC code and the 66-byte palette pair builder; next-state closure is checked.
